subject: Human Body
title: Feedback Loops
description: A fast breakdown of Feedback Loops for builders.

hook.text: Your body keeps hormone levels balanced the same way a thermostat controls temperature: with feedback loops.

buildup.text: Negative feedback: when hormone levels rise too high, the gland reduces production.

discovery.text: Example: high thyroid hormone tells the pituitary to stop sending TSH. Low thyroid hormone triggers more TSH production.

twist.text: Positive feedback is rare but powerful. During childbirth, oxytocin triggers contractions that release more oxytocin.

climax.text: Feedback loops maintain stability. Without them, hormones would spike or crash unpredictably, causing chaos in the body.

punchline.text: Hormones regulate themselves. Too much shuts production down.

quiz.question: What does negative feedback do in the endocrine system?
options: Reduces hormone production when levels are too high
Destroys excess hormones in the liver
